summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration 45 issues (mobile web 390x844, Pro, localStorage seed). All three items PASS. (1) FolderDropOverlay z-order: during a drag, elementFromPoint at the center of every drop target (fA, fB, Ohne Ordner, Neuer Ordner) returns the target itself. Pointer-events were temporarily forced to auto so the pointerEvents=none overlay could be hit-tested. elementFromPoint at the center of the archive-suggest-banner returns drop-target-fB, and the screenshots show the panel painted above the banner, KPI chips, folder chips and search bar. (2) Drag and press: drop on fB moved p3 into fB; drop on Ohne Ordner cleared p1; drop outside left p4 unchanged; drop on Neuer Ordner showed the prompt and created 'TEST_Drag Neu' with p5 inside. After every drop the URL stayed /projects. A long press without moving (800ms) entered selection mode with p3 selected (checkbox checked, blue border). A normal tap opened /projects/p3. (3) AppointmentPicker: '25:99' and '12:60' showed the alert 'Ungültige Uhrzeit'; '31.02.2026' and 'abc' showed 'Ungültiges Datum'. In all four cases nothing was saved and the modal stayed open. Valid '05.11.2026' + '8:30' saved as 2026-11-05 / 08:30 and the chip reads 'Do., 05.11.26, 08:30 Uhr'. Also checked: '06.11.26' with no time saves without a time.

ui_bugs.issue: The regex accepts a 3-digit year: '05.11.202' would be saved as year 202 and toKey gives '202-11-05'. This is an edge case and was found by code review only, not tested.

issues: The ghost card is centered on the finger, so it covers the label of the hovered drop target. The target is still highlighted by color and scale. Cosmetic: consider offsetting the ghost above the finger.

action_items: Optional: in AppointmentPicker, restrict the year to 2 or 4 digits (\d{2}|\d{4}).
Optional: offset the drag ghost so it does not cover the hovered target's label.
critical_code_review_comments: The overlay root has pointerEvents='none', so a plain elementFromPoint skips it. That is intended: hit-testing uses measureInWindow rects. Future tests must force pointer-events:auto to check paint order.
makeDragGesture(item) is still rebuilt per card per render (from iteration 45, minor).
seed_data_creation: Only localStorage in the test browser contexts: TEST_ projects p1-p6, folders fA/fB, 'TEST_Drag Neu' folder, a Termin on p3. Nothing on the server.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/e2e/home2_seed.py plus drag_folder_helpers.py. To verify overlay paint order, inject the style '*{pointer-events:auto !important}', call elementFromPoint, then remove the style. Alerts on web go through window.alert (webAlertPolyfill), so capture them with page.on('dialog'). Termin modal testIDs: project-appointment, appointment-date-input, appointment-time-input, appointment-save. The web clock is Nov 2026.
